title: Clave de Madera
description: A tuned wooden click driven by the 3-2 son clave pattern, shaped from a triangle oscillator with a sharp pitch-envelope snap and bandpass resonance for that hollow knock. Over 16 cycles the filter center, pan, and crush depth drift on mutually-prime LFO clocks (7, 11, 13, 17 cycles), keeping the click's tone alive and restless while ghost hits scatter on off-beats.
code:
setcpm(96/4)
stack(
  note("<a4 a4 a4 a4 a4 a4 a4 a4>/1")
    .s("triangle")
    .struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~")
    .penv("<24 24 19 19 24 19 24 19>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.04)
    .decay(0.06).sustain(0).release(0.01)
    .bpf(sine.slow(11).range(900, 2800)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(6, 16))
    .lpf(sine.slow(7).range(1800, 5000))
    .shape(sine.slow(17).range(0.25, 0.55))
    .crush(sine.slow(13).range(6, 14))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.gain(0.28).speed(1.5))
    .room(0.06).gain(0.88)
)
